pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Balla Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via d2 to c4 or f1-e3; plan 2 used a closed c-file. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed 7...d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nbd2 before the d-pawn moved; plan 3's Qh5 attack was unsound; plan 4 played ...b7-b6 with the pawn on b5. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed 7...d6 8.c3 Na5
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via d2 with the d-pawn still there; plan 3 said White prevents ...c5; plan 4 gave Black a queenside majority it lacks. Rewrote plans 1, 2 (unreadable b7 reference), 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed 7...d6 8.c3 Na5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 proposed ...Qc7, already played. Rewrote overview (adding that ...Bg4 is still possible without h3) and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 6...b5
pages.notes: Overview called 6...b5 sharp and tactical and missed its point (ending the Bxc6 and Nxe5 threat); plan 1 pushed d4 before Bb3; plan 3 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 8.c3
pages.notes: Overview did not mention that 8.c3 allows the Marshall Gambit; plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote overview and plan 1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 8.d3 d6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 sent the f3-knight on the d2-f1-g3 route meant for the queen's knight. Rewrote overview and plan 1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 8.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 gave ...c5-c4 before ...Na5; plan 3 called 9.d3 the Chigorin; plan 4 gave ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6. Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Anti-Marshall 8.a4 b4
pages.notes: Overview and plan 4 gave Black a passed a-pawn that does not exist; plan 2 routed a knight from b8, where there is none; plan 1 played Nf1-e3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Anti-Marshall 8.a4 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3. Rewrote plan 3. British spelling.
